fee_notes: Royalty 6% of Gross Sales due 10th of each month. Brand Fund 2% of Gross Sales (max 3% on 30-days notice). Local Advertising Requirement: $5,000/mo months 4-12, $4,000/mo months 13-36, 2% of Gross Sales month 37+ (or greater of 2% or $3,500/mo if 6+ months of negative YOY sales in rolling 12-month period). Advertising Cooperatives 1-2% if established (none currently). No royalty floor disclosed.
